variants.title: Mending Nets
variants.premise: The fisher crouches on the dock, working a bone needle through a torn net.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Any idea how I could get a boat out of here?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Ships aren't my business. Talk to the harbour folk, not me.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: So you don't know anything about it?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: I know sharks and tides. That's the lot.

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: The fisher tugs the knot tight without looking up.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Suits me. Less talking.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Nets. Tides. Sharks. Good boats.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Nothing about ships leaving, though.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Not my trade, outerlander.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Don't mention it.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Shark, off the rocks, when the tide allows it.

variants.title: Bad Catch
variants.premise: The fisher slams a half-full creel onto the dock, cursing the tide.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Is there a ship leaving the coast soon?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Do I look like a ship to you?

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: You don't sound like you'd help anyway.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: I wouldn't.

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: The fisher spits over the rail and goes back to the ropes.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Half a creel of fish and a split net. Rough enough.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Rocks are that way. Fish are that way. Ships, no idea.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Good. Go bother someone else.

options.label: You Fremennik are all the same.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: And proud of it.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Fair enough.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Move along, outerlander.

variants.title: Quiver Recognised
variants.premise: The fisher is coiling a wet line by the pilings when the player approaches.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Is there any way I could get a ship out of here?

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: The fisher's eyes catch on the quiver on your back.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Colosseum-make, unless my eyes have gone soft.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Does that help me any?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Not from me. But it might, up at the harbour in the capital.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Fortis Cothon, they call it. Ask for whoever runs the ledger.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Never had reason to. My boats stay close to the rocks.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Didn't say that.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Close enough, then.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Don't push it.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Mind the tide on your way out, outerlander.
